statements.status_notes: GHSA-wfqx-gjrf-g28r is a TOCTOU in Crossplane's package signature verification: when a package is installed by mutable tag with signature verification enabled, a malicious registry can serve a correctly signed image for verification and then unsigned content for installation, because the tag is resolved separately for each step. Upstream fixed this only in v2.3.3 and v2.2.3 (backported to the v2.3 and v2.2 release branches; for v2.3 the fix ships via the crossplane-runtime v2.3.3 bump). The fix was not backported to the v2.1, v2.0, or v1.x release lines, so these tracks cannot adopt it without crossing a minor or major version boundary; the crossplane 2.2 and 2.3 tracks already ship the fixed releases and are not affected. Mitigation: install Crossplane packages by image digest rather than by mutable tag. A safe upgrade path for these tracks is under investigation.
